label: E-7-4 skilled technical status: annual issuance quota
appliesTo: E-9, E-10 and H-2 holders applying to convert to E-7-4 skilled technical status
why: The only route by which a non-professional worker reaches a long-stay status with family accompaniment, and it is rationed. A quota means the qualifying criteria are a threshold rather than an entitlement, and the number is set annually — so whether the route is realistically open in a given year is a fact about policy, not about the applicant. Worth watching in both directions: it has been expanded before.

history.source: Ministry of Justice — 2026 E-7-4 operating plan
history.note: For 2026, with the scope of eligible employment widened in some sectors including agriculture and fisheries. Base eligibility is a registered foreign national with four or more years of stay on E-9, E-10 or H-2 within the last ten years, subject to points criteria covering income, Korean language ability, age, work history and employer recommendation.
